title: the active contributions of a panel page, contract version 1
description: The prop cms.contributions of every panel page behind the login (PRD 13.4): for each point the page renders, the contributions the server resolved for this viewer and request, in the order the host renders them. A contribution is listed only when it is enabled, in scope and the viewer holds the permission its scope requires; any other is never sent. Each carries the point's props as the point's generated codec wrote them at the lower of the viewer's classification access and the addon's reads capability. A contribution with data gets it as the deferred prop ext.<addon>, under its id. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Panel\Domain\Dto\ContributionsProp, and the generated codec writes its canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace.

points.description: Each point the page renders that has an active contribution, in the order the page lists its points.

fill.description: One active contribution to the point.

addon.description: The namespace of the addon that contributes it.

data.description: Whether the contribution reads data: its query's result comes as the deferred prop ext.<addon>, under the contribution's id, and is absent there when the query was refused, rejected or failed.

id.description: The contribution's id, `<namespace>.<local>`, under which the addon's bundle registers its code.

kind.description: The kind of contribution, the kind of the point.

priority.description: The priority it renders at, as cms:build compiled it with the installation's settings; the lowest first.

props.description: The point's props as the point's generated codec wrote them for this contribution, without every member classified above the lower of the viewer's access and the addon's reads.

point.description: One point the page renders, with its active contributions.

fills.description: The point's active contributions in the order the host renders them: priority with the lowest first, then the addon's namespace, then the contribution's id.
